intro: Deathguard Billmuth asks you to recover Scarlet Crusade attack plans from Venomweb Vale. The plans could help the Deathguard prepare for an expected assault.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush.
You are clearly an impressive adventurer. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for saving my friend, friend. I will take these plans back to my commander and we will give those crusaders a welcoming they won't forget.

I know that many among our people mistrust you adventurers, but it's clear to me that you are Forsaken through and through. I won't forget this, and I'll make sure others know of what you did here today.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
